finding.title: The code uses SHA-256, which is a cryptographic hash function, not a password hashing function.
The code does not enforce any password strength requirements.
SHA-256 is not designed for password hashing and lacks the necessary features such as salting and adaptive hashing.
The code does not include a salt, which is essential to protect against rainbow table attacks.
